name: screen-clean
title: Screen Clean
description: Black out every display and optionally lock the keyboard so you can clean your screen and keyboard.
author: yanggong-zi

preferences.name: duration
preferences.title: Cleaning Duration
preferences.description: How long the screen stays black. The session always ends automatically.

preferences.name: strictKeyboardLock
preferences.title: Strict Keyboard Lock
preferences.description: Swallow keyboard events system-wide. macOS needs Accessibility permission; Windows uses a low-level keyboard hook.
preferences.label: Lock keyboard globally

preferences.name: showExitHint
preferences.title: Exit Hint
preferences.description: Show a faint hint explaining how to exit before the screen goes fully black.
preferences.label: Show the exit hint

commands.name: start-cleaning
commands.title: Start Cleaning Mode
commands.subtitle: Screen Clean
commands.description: Black out all displays and optionally lock the keyboard.

commands.name: grant-accessibility
commands.title: Grant Keyboard Lock Permission
commands.subtitle: Screen Clean
commands.description: Request Accessibility permission for the ScreenCleaner helper used by strict keyboard lock.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish this extension to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
